headline: Panathinaikos bring 5-1 form to Almaty as clear favourites
summary: Panathinaikos arrive in Almaty after a 5-1 win over Asteras Tripolis on Sunday, and across 10 bookmakers they are 59% favourites to win this Conference League game. Their last defeat came at Olympiakos, where they managed only 0.47 expected goals, which shows how a compact defence can limit them. Kairat drew at Riga despite conceding 2.31 expected goals, and have won their last two at home. Neestrup beat Kairat 3-2 last season, gazzetta.gr reports. The market rates Panathinaikos 0.89 goals better, and expects 2.6 goals — a win for the Greeks looks likely, a comfortable one less so.
read: Panathinaikos are strong away favourites at around 59%, having won four of five and hammered Asteras Tripolis 5-1 on Sunday, while Kairat's only Conference League point came in a 1-1 at Riga where they were out-created. The market rates the Greeks about a goal the better and leans just over 2.5 goals, with the main question being whether Kairat's strong home scoring form can turn this into a closer game than the prices suggest.

facts.fact: Panathinaikos are priced at 59.0% to win away, more than three times Kairat's 17.0% chance (draw 23.9%).
facts.meaning: The market sees this as one of the clearest away favourites of the round, not a close game.

facts.fact: Panathinaikos beat Asteras Tripolis 5-1 at home on Sunday, with 5.8 xG to 0.91 against.
facts.meaning: They come into this with their attack at its most productive of the season.

facts.fact: Panathinaikos' only defeat in their last five was 0-1 at Olympiakos, where they managed just 0.47 xG.
facts.meaning: Against a well-organised side that denies them space, their chance creation drops sharply.

facts.fact: On the handicap the market rates Panathinaikos about 0.9 goals better, with the main line at Kairat +1.
Kairat beat Irtysh 5-0 at home in the Kazakh Premier League on Sunday.
facts.meaning: They arrive with confidence and a home crowd behind them, four days after their last match.

facts.fact: In their Conference League draw at Riga, Kairat were out-created 1.15 xG to 2.31.
facts.meaning: Their European point came from resilience rather than control — they conceded the better chances.

facts.fact: Panathinaikos have 3 points from their opening Conference League game, Kairat 1; the Greeks sit 11th and Kairat 18th in the 36-team table.
facts.meaning: A win here puts Panathinaikos on six points from two and in strong position in the league phase.

facts.fact: Over 2.5 goals is priced at 52.2%, with the market's fair total at 2.6 goals.
facts.meaning: Slightly more likely than not to be a three-goal game — the market is not expecting a stalemate.

sources.fact: Kairat coach Rafael Urazbakhtin said his side will face Panathinaikos with courage and discipline and without fear.
Rafael Urazbakhtin praised Panathinaikos and their coach Jacob Neestrup in his pre-match press conference.
Panathinaikos coach Jacob Neestrup faced Kairat Almaty last season and beat them 3-2.
Gazzetta reports that Jacob Neestrup's choice of formation against Kairat Almaty will determine Panathinaikos' personnel from midfield forward.
Panathinaikos are chasing a second consecutive win in the Conference League league phase against Kairat Almaty.
Gazzetta columnist Nikos Athanasiou writes that Panathinaikos bounced back strongly against Asteras Tripolis, highlighting a complete performance from Louza.
